text.zh-CN: 会厌炎会使气管入口附近肿胀，是可能堵住呼吸的急症。
text.en: Epiglottitis is swelling near the entrance to the windpipe that can obstruct breathing.

text.en: The epiglottis is a cartilage flap protecting the airway during swallowing; swelling can block airflow even when not eating.

text.zh-CN: Hib是b型流感嗜血杆菌，属于细菌而不是流感病毒；肺炎链球菌、葡萄球菌等也可能引起感染。
text.en: Hib means Haemophilus influenzae type b, a bacterium rather than influenza virus. Pneumococcus and staphylococci are other possible causes.

text.en: Very hot liquids, caustic substances, smoke or throat injury can cause similar danger. Immune suppression and incomplete Hib vaccination increase concern.

text.en: Treat severe throat pain with difficult swallowing, drooling, muffled voice or noisy inhalation as an emergency, particularly with laboured breathing or a need to sit leaning forward.

text.en: Grey or blue lips, reduced responsiveness, marked drowsiness or slowing breathing may indicate severe oxygen deprivation; report these changes to the dispatcher immediately.
